purpose: Compact grammar constraints for generating valid modular time-series forecasting models from the A-E module library.

grammar.A: Identity | Z-score | RevIN | Differencing | Series Decomposition | Patch | Mask
grammar.B: Linear Block | MLP Block | CNN Block | TCN Block | GRU Block | LSTM Block | State Space Model Block | Transformer Encoder Block | Basis Block
grammar.C: Linear Head | MLP Head | Basis Projection
grammar.D: AutoD only: Inverse Z-score | Inverse RevIN | Inverse Differencing | Decomposition Recomposition
grammar.E: Single Block | Sequential Composition | Parallel Additive Branches | Residual Modeling | Gated Fusion

selection_rules: A is optional. Select it only when data features justify preprocessing or transformation.
B is mandatory and is the core modeling component. Select 1-3 B modules.
C is mandatory for point forecasting. Select exactly one prediction head.
D cannot be freely selected. It is automatically added according to A.
E is mandatory. Select exactly one composition paradigm to connect B modules.

composition_rules.Sequential Composition: requires 2-3 B modules connected in order
composition_rules.Parallel Additive Branches: requires 2-3 B branches with additive fusion
composition_rules.Residual Modeling: requires a base B module and a residual B module
composition_rules.Gated Fusion: requires 2-3 B branches with learned gated fusion

hard_constraints: Use only modules listed in the module library.
Keep tensor shapes compatible across modules.
Final output shape must be [B, pre_len, station_num].
